messages.subject: Handling categorical variables  in INLA
parts:
Hello,

I am fitting a spatial survival model using INLA. I have encountered two problems;

1. I am getting an error if include categorical variables such as factor(sex) in the model. I don't get errors if I include continuous variables only in the model. The error is

Error in inla(formula, family = "weibull", data = inla.stack.data(stk),  : 
  With control.fixed = list(expand.factor.strategy='model.matrix'), then NA's in factor are not allowd. Please use strategy 'inla' instead.


2. In addition, I have a model that includes both patient-level frailties and spatial (village-level) frailties. But am also getting this error

Error in model.frame.default(formula = y...fake ~ spatial + patID, data = list( : 
  variable lengths differ (found for 'patID')

Definitely, I have number of patients more than village points. Why complaining about different lengths?


Please any suggestions as how to address these error will be greatly appreciated.

Thank,
Emmanuel
